evidence.quote: [Using AWS CloudTrail events to monitor backup policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_backup_cloudtrail.md)

name: AWS CloudTrail events to monitor backup policies
summary: You can use AWS CloudTrail events to monitor when backup policies are created, updated, or deleted from any accounts in your organization, or when there is an invalid organizational backup plan.
